##### Summary
Fixes #7555 and https://github.com/netdata/product/issues/144 

##### Component Name
Health
##### Additional Information
Explaining the road selected to bring #7555 and updated on https://github.com/netdata/product/issues/144.

- The labels need to be added to ALARM_ENTRY and the line must start with `L`.

To test this feature, it is only necessary to create an alarm with label.

```

```

Why the difference?

> Why the difference?

You already had logs that were created without labels and Netdata assigned NULL to strcuture, because it was allocated with `callocz`.

> > Why the difference?

> You already had logs that were created without labels and Netdata assigned NULL to strcuture, because it was allocated with `callocz`.

So the behavior after this patch is to use `"label" : ""` and the `"label" : "null"` is just historical. This would make sense from the position in the log, although I can't verify the timestamps.

issue_context.title: Complete the alarms support for labels.
issue_context.body:
There were some tasks left over from #7096 that needed to be completed after a dependency was resolved. In order to add the labels to the alarm_log there are several parts that were not discussed. 

* The labels need to be added to ALARM_ENTRY. 
* The health-log.db format needs to be expanded. 
* Write/parse labels to/from the file.
* Don't store labels in each alarm entry in the alarm log, but put all of them in a new type of line (e.g. L l1=v1 l2=v2 l3=v4)
